analysis_definition.global_fit: proper-rotation Kabsch fit on all 1,312 A-H protein CAs in canonical chain/position order
analysis_definition.pairs: all ten unordered within-variant seed pairs for each stage; pairwise values are not independent model replicates
analysis_definition.relaxed_outputs: all completed models included; force-converged-only statistics use pairs where both models meet the recorded force tolerance
analysis_definition.scope: descriptive static structural variation; no catalytic activity or causal heterogeneity inference
